Key Projects
•Taxi Revanue Estimation (Using Python )|MTH209
Mentor: Dr. Subhajit Dutta, Department of Mathematics and Statistics, IIT Kanpur. ( Feb’24-Apr’24 )
Objective Developed a model to estimate taxi revenue in New York City by analyzing historical NYC big dataset
Methodology Collected and analyzed publicly available NYC taxi trip data, Developed a Poisson process-based optimization model
to estimate and maximize taxi fleet revenue, achieving actionable insights for optimal fleet size and profitability.
Result Achieved revenue estimation of approximately $200/day per taxi in a competitive market with 14K taxis.
•Telecom Customer Churn Prediction (Using Python )|MTH443A
Mentor: Prof. Amit Mitra, Department of Mathematics and Statistics, IIT Kanpur. ( Sep’24-Oct’24 )
Objective Designed and implemented a predictive model to identify high-risk customers prone to churn, enabling data-driven
retention strategies.
Methodology Conducted data preprocessing, feature selection, and applied machine learning algorithms such as logistic regression
and random forests; optimized using hyperparameter tuning and cross-validation
Result Achieved an accuracy of 88% and precision of 0.87, providing actionable insights for reducing customer churn.
•Time-series Analysis: Nifty-50 Stock Price Dataset ( using Python )|MTH442 (jul’24-Aug’24 )
Objective Explore time-series analysis techniques to predict stock prices and trends using Nifty-50 stock market data, focusing
on seasonality and autocorrelations.
Methodology Applied feature engineering techniques, visualized key trends, and built predictive models such as ARIMA, ARIMAX,
LSTMs, and RNNs. Evaluated model performance using metrics like RMSE and MAE for improved accuracy.
Result Achieved RMSE scores of 32.30 (Autoregressors), 82.27 (ARIMAX), and significantly improved results with LSTM
and RNN models (RMSE of 0.046, MAE of 0.0370), providing robust stock price predictions for financial analysis.
